name: Banana almond oat porridge
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for about 5 minutes, stirring often.
Top with sliced banana and chopped almonds.

name: Vegetable upma
steps: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in hot oil, then soften the onion, chili and vegetables.
Add about 2 parts water to 1 part semolina, bring to a boil, stir in the semolina and cover until fluffy.

name: Egg bhurji with toast
steps: Fry onion, chili and tomato in oil with turmeric until soft.
Add beaten eggs and scramble until just set; serve with toast.

name: Puttu with black chickpea curry
steps: Soak and boil the chickpeas until tender.
Steam moistened rice flour layered with coconut until cooked through.
Temper spices, cook onion and tomato, add chickpeas and simmer into a thick curry.

name: Rice-flour appam with vegetable stew
steps: Make a thin batter from rice flour, water, sugar and a little coconut milk; cook in a lidded pan as lacy pancakes.
Simmer potato, carrot, onion, ginger and chili in the remaining coconut milk and water until soft; season with pepper.

name: Peanut poha
steps: Rinse the poha and drain. Fry peanuts, mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil.
Cook diced potato and onion with turmeric, fold in poha and finish with lemon juice.

name: Tomato and cheese omelette
steps: Soften onion and tomato in oil.
Pour in beaten eggs, add cheese, fold and cook until set.

name: Yogurt, apple and oat bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with diced apple, oats and chopped almonds.

name: Avocado toast with egg
steps: Toast the bread and mash avocado with lemon, salt and pepper.
Fry or poach the egg and place on top.

name: Turmeric tofu scramble with toast
steps: Sauté onion and pepper, crumble in the tofu and add turmeric and salt.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve on toast.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Cook onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil, add spices and tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until set; finish with herbs and serve with bread.

name: Ginger rice congee with egg
steps: Simmer rice with ginger and carrot in plenty of water for about 30 minutes until creamy.
Stir in spinach, top with a soft-boiled egg and soy sauce.

name: Black bean breakfast burrito
steps: Use soaked and boiled black beans. Scramble the eggs with onion and tomato in oil.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, beans and cheese and roll up.

name: Tamago omelette rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk eggs with soy sauce and sugar and cook in thin layers, rolling as you go.
Slice the omelette and serve over rice with cucumber.

name: Banana pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with egg, milk and flour into a batter.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan, about 2 minutes per side.

name: Kerala fish curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice. Fry onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in oil, then add chili, turmeric and tomato.
Add coconut milk and a little water, simmer, then add the fish and cook gently 8-10 minutes.

name: Nadan egg curry with rice
steps: Hard-boil the eggs and cook the rice.
Brown onion, ginger and garlic, add spices and tomato, then coconut milk; simmer and add the eggs.

name: Kerala chicken stew with rice
steps: Sweat onion, ginger and chili in oil, add chicken, potato, carrot and water; simmer until tender.
Stir in coconut milk and pepper, warm through and serve with rice.

name: Avial (mixed vegetables in coconut) with rice
steps: Steam the vegetables with turmeric and salt until just tender.
Grind coconut, chili and cumin, mix in yogurt and fold through the vegetables; finish with curry leaves and oil.

name: Cabbage thoran with moong dal and rice
steps: Boil the dal with turmeric until soft; cook the rice.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, stir-fry shredded cabbage and onion, and finish with coconut.

name: Cassava with fish curry
steps: Peel and boil the cassava with salt until tender, then drain.
Make a curry base of onion, ginger, garlic, spices and tomato, add coconut milk and poach the fish; serve with cassava.

name: Vegetable sambar with rice
steps: Boil the lentils with turmeric until soft; cook the rice.
Simmer the vegetables in water with chili powder, add the lentils, then pour over a mustard seed and curry leaf tempering.

name: Dal tadka with rice
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric and tomato until soft; cook the rice.
Fry cumin, garlic, onion and chili in oil and pour over the dal; top with herbs.

name: Chana masala with roti
steps: Use soaked and boiled chickpeas. Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil, add spices and tomato until jammy.
Simmer the chickpeas in the masala. Knead flour with water and cook flat roti on a dry pan.

name: Rajma (kidney bean curry) with rice
steps: Use soaked kidney beans boiled until soft; cook the rice.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic, spices and tomato in oil, add the beans with some cooking liquid and simmer until thick.

name: Paneer tomato curry with roti
steps: Cook onion and garlic in oil, add tomato sauce and garam masala and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in milk and cubed paneer; serve with roti cooked from flour and water.

name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Brown the onion in oil, add ginger, garlic, spices and tomato and cook down.
Add chicken and yogurt, cover and simmer 20 minutes; serve with rice.

name: Palak paneer with rice
steps: Wilt the spinach and blend it into a smooth puree.
Cook cumin, onion and garlic in oil, add the puree and spices, then the paneer cubes; serve with rice.

name: Vegetable biryani
steps: Fry onion until golden, add ginger, garlic, vegetables, yogurt and garam masala and cook briefly.
Layer with par-boiled rice, cover tightly and steam on low heat for 15 minutes; top with herbs.

name: Aloo gobi with roti
steps: Fry cumin and onion in oil, add tomato, turmeric, potato and cauliflower; cover and cook until tender.
Finish with garam masala and serve with roti made from flour and water.

name: Mediterranean chickpea couscous bowl
steps: Use soaked and boiled chickpeas. Steep the couscous in boiling water until fluffy.
Toss with diced cucumber, tomato, onion, crumbled cheese, olive oil, lemon and herbs.

name: Hummus and vegetable pita plate
steps: Use soaked and boiled chickpeas. Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic, olive oil and salt until smooth.
Serve with sliced cucumber, carrot sticks and bread.

name: Pasta arrabbiata
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Warm garlic, chili and herbs in olive oil, add tomato sauce and simmer 8 minutes; toss with pasta and cheese.

name: Lemon garlic vegetable pasta
steps: Boil the pasta and add the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Sauté zucchini and garlic in olive oil, toss with pasta, broccoli, lemon, herbs and pepper.

name: Lemon herb chicken with couscous
steps: Pan-sear seasoned chicken with garlic and herbs until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Sauté zucchini and pepper, steep couscous in boiling water, and finish everything with lemon juice.

name: Mushroom risotto
steps: Brown the mushrooms in olive oil and set aside. Soften onion and garlic, then toast the rice.
Add hot water a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes; fold in mushrooms and cheese.

name: Chicken fajita wraps
steps: Use soaked and boiled black beans. Sear sliced chicken with chili powder and cumin, then cook the pepper and onion until charred.
Fill tortillas with chicken, vegetables, beans and cheese and finish with lemon.

name: Black bean and corn rice bowl
steps: Use soaked and boiled black beans. Cook the rice and warm the beans with cumin and corn in oil.
Top the rice with beans, tomato, onion, avocado and lemon.

name: Pepper and bean quesadilla
steps: Use boiled black beans. Soften the pepper and onion in a little oil.
Fill tortillas with vegetables, beans and cheese and toast on both sides until crisp.

name: Tofu and broccoli stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice. Pan-fry cubed tofu in oil until golden and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and vegetables, return the tofu and toss with soy sauce.

name: Egg fried rice
steps: Use cooled cooked rice. Scramble the eggs in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry ginger, onion, carrot and peas, add the rice and soy sauce, then fold the eggs back in.

name: Shrimp and peanut noodle stir-fry
steps: Soak or boil the noodles according to the pack and drain.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and vegetables, add the shrimp until pink, then toss with noodles, soy sauce, lemon and crushed peanuts.

name: Coconut vegetable and tofu curry
steps: Cook the rice. Fry ginger, garlic and chili in oil, add the vegetables and coconut milk and simmer until tender.
Add cubed tofu and soy sauce, heat through and finish with herbs.

name: Japanese-style chicken and egg rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice. Simmer sliced onion and chicken in water with soy sauce and sugar until cooked.
Pour beaten egg over the top, cover until just set, and serve over rice.

name: Beef and vegetable bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice. Brown the beef with garlic and soy sauce.
Sauté each vegetable quickly in oil, arrange over rice with the beef and a fried egg.

name: Lemony red lentil soup with bread
steps: Soften onion, carrot, garlic and cumin in olive oil.
Add lentils and water, simmer 20 minutes, blend partly and finish with lemon; serve with bread.

name: Baked falafel plate
steps: Use soaked (not cooked) chickpeas. Pulse with onion, garlic, cumin, herbs and flour, shape into patties.
Bake with a little olive oil at 200 C for 25 minutes, turning once; serve with tahini, salad and bread.

name: West African groundnut stew with rice
steps: Cook the rice. Soften onion, ginger and chili in oil, add tomato and potato with water.
Stir in ground peanuts and simmer until thick, then add spinach.

name: Chicken jollof rice
steps: Fry onion and pepper in oil, add tomato sauce and chili powder and cook until the oil separates.
Add chicken, rice and water, cover tightly and cook on low heat until the rice is tender.

name: Beef and bean chili with rice
steps: Use soaked and boiled kidney beans; cook the rice.
Brown beef with onion and pepper, add spices, tomato sauce and beans, and simmer 25 minutes.

name: Baked fish with potatoes and broccoli
steps: Toss diced potatoes with olive oil and roast at 210 C for 15 minutes.
Add the fish, broccoli, garlic, herbs and lemon to the tray and roast 15 minutes more.

name: Peanut vegetable noodle stir-fry
steps: Prepare the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables, toss with noodles and soy sauce and top with peanuts.

name: Quinoa, chickpea and avocado bowl
steps: Use boiled chickpeas. Simmer quinoa in water for 15 minutes and fluff.
Top with chickpeas, tomato, cucumber and avocado; dress with lemon, olive oil and herbs.

name: Coconut chickpea sundal
steps: Use boiled chickpeas. Temper mustard seeds, chili and curry leaves in oil.
Toss with chickpeas, coconut and salt.

name: Apple with peanuts
steps: Slice the apple and serve with the peanuts.

name: Cucumber raita
steps: Grate the cucumber and mix with yogurt, roasted cumin and salt.

name: Hummus with vegetable sticks
steps: Use boiled chickpeas. Blend with tahini, lemon and salt.
Serve with carrot and cucumber sticks.

name: Banana milk shake
steps: Blend the banana with cold milk until smooth.

name: Masala boiled eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and halve.
Sprinkle with chili powder, pepper and salt.

name: Banana fritters (pazham pori)
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, salt and water into a thick batter.
Dip banana slices in the batter and shallow-fry until golden.

name: Corn chaat
steps: Boil the corn for 5 minutes and drain.
Toss with onion, tomato, lemon, chili powder and salt.

name: Peanut and banana toast
steps: Toast the bread, top with sliced banana and crushed peanuts.

name: Guacamole with toasted tortilla
steps: Mash avocado with lemon, tomato, onion and salt.
Toast the tortilla in a dry pan or toaster, cut into wedges and dip.

name: Idli with sambar
steps: Soak rice and urad dal separately, grind, mix, ferment overnight, then steam the batter in idli moulds.
Boil the lentils, simmer with vegetables, tomato and spices, and finish with a mustard seed and curry leaf tempering.

name: Masala dosa with coconut chutney
steps: Soak, grind and ferment rice and urad dal into a batter; spread thin on a hot pan and crisp with a little oil.
Cook onion and potato with turmeric and tempering for the filling; grind coconut and chili for the chutney.

name: Besan chilla (chickpea-flour pancakes)
steps: Whisk besan with water, spices and salt into a pourable batter and stir in chopped onion, tomato, chili and herbs.
Cook thin pancakes in a lightly oiled pan until golden on both sides.

name: Moong dal chilla
steps: Soak the moong dal for 3 hours, drain and blend with ginger, chili, cumin and salt.
Cook thin pancakes in a lightly oiled pan; top with onion.

name: Cucumber tomato cheese sandwich
steps: Layer cheese, cucumber and tomato between slices of bread, season, and press or toast if you like.

name: Overnight oats with apple and almonds
steps: Mix oats and milk and chill overnight.
Top with diced apple and chopped almonds.

name: Lemon rice with peanuts
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool slightly.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, chili and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric, toss with rice and lemon juice; serve with sliced cucumber.

name: Curd rice
steps: Cook the rice until very soft and mix with yogurt and salt.
Temper mustard seeds, chili, ginger and curry leaves in oil, pour over, and top with grated carrot.

name: Tomato rice with peas
steps: Cook the rice. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, then cook onion, chili and tomato with spices until soft.
Add peas, fold in the rice and heat through.

name: Vegetable pulao
steps: Fry onion, ginger and garlic in oil, add the vegetables and garam masala.
Add rinsed rice and water, cover and cook until the rice is tender; finish with herbs.

name: Moong dal vegetable khichdi
steps: Fry cumin and ginger in oil, add vegetables and turmeric.
Add rinsed rice and dal with plenty of water and cook until soft and porridge-like.

name: Chapati with dal
steps: Boil the lentils with turmeric until soft, then pour over a tempering of cumin, garlic, onion and tomato.
Knead flour with water and cook chapatis on a dry pan.

name: Chapati with mixed vegetable curry
steps: Cook onion and tomato with spices into a masala, add the vegetables and a little water and simmer until tender.
Knead flour with water and cook chapatis on a dry pan.

name: Mushroom masala with chapati
steps: Brown the mushrooms, then cook onion, garlic, tomato and spices into a masala and return the mushrooms.
Cook chapatis from flour and water on a dry pan.

name: Kerala egg roast with chapati
steps: Hard-boil the eggs. Cook onion until deeply brown, add ginger, garlic, spices and tomato until the oil separates.
Coat the halved eggs in the roast; serve with chapatis made from flour and water.

name: Kerala fish fry with cabbage thoran and rice
steps: Marinate the fish in chili, turmeric, lemon and salt, then shallow-fry until crisp.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, stir-fry shredded cabbage, finish with coconut; serve with rice.

name: Kerala chicken curry with chapati
steps: Brown onion with ginger, garlic and curry leaves, add spices and tomato, then the chicken and a little water; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk; serve with chapatis made from flour and water.

name: Chicken and quinoa salad bowl
steps: Simmer the quinoa; pan-sear seasoned chicken until cooked and slice it.
Toss with chopped cucumber, tomato and onion, and dress with lemon, olive oil and herbs.

name: Pan-seared fish with vegetables and rice
steps: Cook the rice. Sear the fish in olive oil 3-4 minutes per side and rest.
Sauté zucchini, pepper and garlic; serve with lemon.

name: Spinach dal with rice
steps: Boil the lentils with turmeric until soft; cook the rice.
Fry cumin, onion and garlic, wilt in the spinach, stir into the dal.

name: Paneer bhurji with chapati
steps: Cook onion, chili and tomato with turmeric and garam masala in oil.
Crumble in the paneer and cook briefly; serve with chapatis made from flour and water.
